Design Motivation

Problems & Goals

From fragmented weekly reporting to a complete AI-assisted workflow

!Problems
01

Weekly reports are repetitive and time-consuming.

02

Students need structure, language support, and completeness checking.

03

Teachers spend too much time reviewing and commenting manually.

04

Progress, feedback, and submission status are difficult to track clearly.

◎Goals
01

Simplify report creation with a guided weekly workflow.

02

Embed AI for generation, polishing, checking, and revision.

03

Improve teacher review efficiency through reusable comments and batch operations.

04

Provide analytics dashboards for report status and learning progress.

Implementation Highlights

Technical Execution

From functional prototype to AI-assisted product workflow

01
Development Process

Feature design, implementation, AI integration, testing, and iteration.

Step 1 Requirement Analysis

Define student / teacher roles, report workflow, feedback loop, analytics, and tools.

Step 2 Interface Refactoring

Build SaaS-style sidebar, dashboard cards, tables, status badges, and tool panels.

Step 3 AI Workflow Integration

Connect report generation, polishing, completeness checking, and feedback-based revision.

Step 4 Testing & Optimization

Adjust charts, layout, export functions, data backup, and role-based page switching.

02
Technical Highlights

Key implementation points that support the final application.

Role-Based UI

Student and teacher panels share one shell but provide separate workflows.

Structured Report Data

Tasks, problems, plans, summaries, status, progress, and feedback are organized as records.

AI Model Configuration

Provider, endpoint, model name, and local model settings are configurable.

Reusable Feedback

Teacher review supports comments, templates, batch operations, and student replies.

Analytics Charts

Submission rate, status distribution, average progress, and problem distribution are visualized.

Data Management

Backup, export, AI call history, and future sharing modules are supported.

Final Summary

Conclusion & Future Work

Project value, current outcomes, and next iteration plan

Project Outcomes

  • Built a complete dual-role weekly report management platform.
  • Integrated AI into the real report-writing workflow.
  • Improved teacher review efficiency with batch review and feedback templates.
  • Combined reporting, analytics, academic tools, and data management in one workspace.

Future Work

  • Deploy an online web version.
  • Improve cross-platform support.
  • Add friend-based sharing for reports and files.
  • Expand AI agent capabilities and visual analytics.
UniversalWeekly demonstrates how AI can turn routine weekly reporting into a smarter and more efficient academic workflow.
